questions.question: Dhruv's birthday is on Sunday 28 th May. On what day of the week will be Sahil's Birthday in the same year if Sahil was born on 19 th October?
questions.questionHtml: Dhruv's birthday is on Sunday 28th May. On what day of the week will be Sahil's Birthday in the same year if Sahil was born on 19th October?
questions.solution:
Dhruv's birthday is on Sunday 28th May.

⇒ 28th May → Sunday

Sahil was born on 19th October.

⇒ 19th October → ?

28th May to 19th October

→ 3 Day in May.

→ 30 Day in June.

→ 31 Day in July.

→ 31 Day in August.

→ 30 Day in September.

→ 19 Day in October.

Total day between 28th May to 19th October = 3 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 19 = 144

⇒ Reminder = 144 % 7 = 140 + 4 = 20 × 7 + 4

Therefore, 4th day after Dhruv’s birthday will be Sahil’s Birthday.

0 → Sunday 1 → Monday; 2 → Tuesday; 3 → Wednesday;

4 → Thursday; 5 → Friday; 6 → Saturday

Sahil’s Borthday = Druv’s Birthday + 4th day = Sunday + 4th day = Thursday.

questions.question: A series is given, with one number missing. Choose the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series. -7/4, -1, -0.25, ?, 5/4, 2​
questions.questionHtml:
A series is given, with one number missing. Choose the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

-7/4, -1, -0.25, ?, 5/4, 2​
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is that the ¾ = 0.75 is added to each number.

⇒ - 7/4 + ¾ = - 1.75 + 0.75 = - 1  

⇒ - 1 + 0.75 = - 0.25

⇒ - 0.25 + 0.75 = 0.5

⇒ 0.5 + 0.75 = ½ + ¾  = 5/4 = 1.25

⇒ 1.25 + 0.75 = 2

Hence, “0.5” will complete the series.

questions.question: If 35% 31 = 12, 92% 30 = 14 then what is the value of 15% 24 = ?
questions.questionHtml: If 35% 31 = 12, 92% 30 = 14 then what is the value of 15% 24 = ?
questions.solution:
Logic: The pattern followed is that all the digits in the numbers are added.

⇒ 35% 31 = 3 + 5 + 3 + 1 = 12

⇒ 92% 30 = 9 + 2 + 3 + 0 = 14

Similarly, 15% 24 = 1 + 5 + 2 + 4 = 12

Hence, “12” is correct answer.

questions.question: The method of soil conservation in which stones, grass, soil are used to build barriers along contours and trenches are made in front of the barriers to collect water is called?
questions.questionHtml: The method of soil conservation in which stones, grass, soil are used to build barriers along contours and trenches are made in front of the barriers to collect water is called?
questions.solution: Contour barriers are contour strips which intercept downslope flowing water and soil particles. These barriers slow down the water movement and reduce its erosive force. They also filter out and trap many of the suspended soil particles, keeping them from being washed out of the field. A long term advantage of barriers is that soil tends to build up behind them, creating a terrace effect. Barriers can be classified as live (strips of living plants), dead (rocks, crop residues), or mixed (a combination of the previous two).

questions.question: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Rajya Sabha constituency) in Maharashtra.
questions.questionHtml: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Rajya Sabha constituency) in Maharashtra.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 19.

Key Points 

  • The Rajya Sabha (which means the "Council of States") is the top house of the Parliament of India. Maharashtra elects 19 seats and they're indirectly elected by using the kingdom legislators of Maharashtra.
  • The Rajya Sabha or Council of States is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
    • Membership is limited to 250 participants, and the existing Rajya Sabha has 245 individuals.

Additional Information

  • The Rajya Sabha is the higher residence of the Parliament of India.
  • Gujarat elects eleven seats and they are not directly elected by the kingdom legislators of Gujarat.
  • There are eighty parliamentary constituencies and 403 legislative meeting constituencies in Uttar Pradesh.
  • The capability seating ability of the Rajya Sabha is 250 (238 elected, 12 appointed), in step with article 80 of the Indian charter.

questions.question: In male reproductive system, the testes are situated outside the abdominal cavity within a pouch called __________.
questions.questionHtml: In male reproductive system, the testes are situated outside the abdominal cavity within a pouch called __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Scrotum.

Scrotum

  • The testes are situated outside the abdominal cavity within a pouch called the scrotum. 
  • The scrotum helps in maintaining the low temperature of the testes (2–2.5 °C lower than the normal internal body temperature) necessary for spermatogenesis.

Testicular Lobules

  • Each testis has about 250 compartments called testicular lobules.

Glands

  • A gland is an organ that produces and releases substances that perform a specific function in the body.
  • Two types of Glands-Endocrine, Exocrine.

Seminiferous Tubules

  • Seminiferous tubules are located in the testicles.
  • Sperms are produced in Seminiferous Tubules.

Male Reproductive System

questions.question: If the force applied on the object is in the direction opposite to the direction of motion, the speed of the object __________.
questions.questionHtml: If the force applied on the object is in the direction opposite to the direction of motion, the speed of the object __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is decreases.Key Points

  • Force: It is defined as the push/pull which is required to change the state of the object.
  • Work: It is the amount of force required to move an object.
  • Work = Force x Displacement.
    • If the direction of applied force and direction, in which an object moves, are perpendicular to each other, then the work is done = 0 i.e no work is done.
    • Work is done only when a certain force is applied to an object and the object moves a certain distance in the direction of the applied force. Hence work done is zero when the direction is perpendicular.

questions.question: The SI unit of acceleration is _________.

questions.question: In Microsoft Excel, the _______ () function returns the smallest value among the values passed as arguments.
questions.questionHtml: In Microsoft Excel, the _______ () function returns the smallest value among the values passed as arguments.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is MIN

Important Points

  • The Excel MIN function returns the smallest value from a supplied set of numeric values.
  • The syntax of the function is:
    • MIN( number1, [number2], ... )
  • where the number arguments are one or more numeric values (or arrays of numeric values), that you want to return the smallest value of.
  • In current versions of Excel (Excel 2007 & later), you can provide up to 255 number arguments to the Min function, but in Excel 2003, the function can only accept up to 30 number arguments.

Key Points

  • If an argument is supplied to the function as a reference to a cell, or an array of cells, the Min function will ignore blank cells, and text or logical values contained within the supplied cell range. However, logical values and text representations of numbers that are supplied directly to the function will be included in the calculation.

questions.question: Akbar was _________ years old when he became emperor.
questions.questionHtml: Akbar was _________ years old when he became emperor.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 13 years.

Key Points

  • Akbar was one of the mightiest emperors during the Mughal Era.
  • He was born in October 1542 and died on 27th October 1605.
  • Akbar was the third Mughal Emperor.
  • His reign was between 1556-1605 AD.
  • In 1555, Humayan died just months after retaking Delhi. Akbar ascended the Mughal throne at the age of 13 and became Shahanshah ("King of Kings"). He was crowned in 1556
  • His regent was Bayram Khan, his childhood guardian, and an outstanding warrior/statesman.

Additional Information

  • He is known for his liberal religious policies, relationship with Indian kings, conquests, etc.
  • In 1564, he abolished the jizyah tax levied on non-muslims.
  • Akbar introduced Mansabdari System in his administration.

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of R and S is 11 : 17. Before 11 years, the ratio of their ages was 11 ∶ 20. What is R's present age (in years)?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of present ages of R and S is 11 : 17. Before 11 years, the ratio of their ages was 11 ∶ 20. What is R's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of R be r and S be s

According to the problem statement

⇒ r/s = 11/17

⇒ s = 17r/11     ----(1)

According to the problem statement 11 years ago,

⇒ (r - 11)/(s - 11) = 11/20

⇒ 20r - 220 = 11s - 121 Using (1)

⇒ 20r - 17r = 99

⇒ r = 99/3 = 33

∴ R’s present age is 33 years

questions.question: If Sec θ = 25/24, then what is the value of Sin θ?

questions.solution:
Given Sec θ = 25/24, so Cos θ = 24/25 Sin θ can be given as

⇒ Sin θ = √(1 – cos2θ) = \(\sqrt{1-(\frac{24}{25})^2}\) = \(\sqrt{\frac{625-576}{(25)^2}}\)

= \(\sqrt{\frac{49}{(25)^2}}\)

= \(\sqrt{(\frac{7}{25})^2}\) = 7/25

∴ Sin θ is 7/25

instead of 2 there must be 0, so that it will be divisible by 11

questions.question: A fraction is greater than its reciprocal by 9/20. What is the fraction?
questions.questionHtml: A fraction is greater than its reciprocal by 9/20. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y – 1/y = 9/20

⇒ 20y2 – 9y – 20 = 0

⇒ y2 - \(\frac{9}{20}\)y - 1 = 0

⇒  \(y^2 +\frac{4}{5}y -\frac{5}{4}y - 1 =0\)

⇒ y(y + 4/5) - 5/4(y + 4/5) = 0

⇒ (y – 5/4)(y + 4/5) = 0

⇒ y = 5/4 or y = -4/5

∴ The fraction is 5/4.

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. Three times this was X-only be compared to the deepest notes of thunder Y-shook with the noise, that can Z-repeated, and each time the earth
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

Three times this was

X-only be compared to the deepest notes of thunder

Y-shook with the noise, that can

Z-repeated, and each time the earth
questions.solution:
The sentence that could follow ‘three times this was..’ is either ‘shook with the noice’ or ‘repeated..’. From these two, option Z makes the best fit because if Y is chosen as the second sentence, X or Z cannot follow it grammatically or structurally. Therefore, Z is the 1st sentence. This rules out option 2 and 4. Till now the sentence is ‘Three times this was repeated, and each time the earth…’, which is meaningfully followed by ‘shook’ and not ‘only be compared’.

This makes ZYX as the best answer.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given. Canonical
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.

Canonical
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Unorthodox.

Key Points

  • The word "canonical" means something that is recognized or accepted as being accurate and authoritative. (मानक)
    • Example: The book is considered canonical within the literary community.
  • "Unorthodox" refers to something that does not conform to traditional or accepted standards or beliefs. (अपरंपरागत)
    • Example: His unorthodox methods in teaching have proven to be very effective.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'canonical' is 'unorthodox'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Approved (स्वीकृत): Officially agreed or accepted as satisfactory.
    • Example: The committee approved the new policy after much deliberation.
  • Official (आधिकारिक): Relating to an authority or public body and its duties, actions, and responsibilities.
    • Example: The official statement was released by the government.
  • Sanctioned (अनुमोदित): Given official permission or approval.
    • Example: The project was sanctioned by the board of directors.

questions.solution: The error lies in the 3rd part of the sentence, where the word ‘into’ has been incorrectly used. The correct word should be ‘in’. The correct sentence should be ‘He was such a wonderful person in so many ways’. The hint lies in the phrase ‘in so many ways’, which has been disturbed by the word ‘into’ here

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given. Disdain
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.

Disdain
questions.solution: Disdain represents a feeling that someone or something is not worthy of respect. ‘Antipathy’ represents lack of respect, which is the synonym of disdain, so rejected. ‘Admiration’ is the act of appreciation, which is the exact opposite, making it the correct answer. ‘Derision’ means mockery and ‘scorn’ means an expression of dislike towards something, which again makes the synonym of disdain.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given. Phonetic
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.

Phonetic
questions.solution: Phonetic is the representation of speech or sounds of speech. From the given words, ‘mute’ represents something silent or without voice. ‘Reticent’ is someone who is not very expressive about one’s feelings readily. ‘Silent’ is the similar of ‘mute’, which means something without voice, and ‘spoken’ is related to speech. Therefore, ‘spoken’ is the similar of ‘phonetic’.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given. To Astound
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.

To Astound
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1.

Key Points

  • The word "To Astound" means to shock or greatly surprise someone. (चकित करना)
    • Example: The magician's tricks never fail to astound the audience.
  • "To Bewilder" means to confuse someone very much. (हक्का-बक्का करना)
    • Example: The complex instructions bewildered the new employees.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • To Tranquil (शांत करना): To make someone or something calm and peaceful.
    • Example: The serene music helped to tranquil the restless children.
  • To Placid (शांत करना): To make someone or something not easily upset or excited.
    • Example: The placid lake was perfect for an afternoon of fishing.
  • To Serene (शांत करना): To make someone or something calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
    • Example: The serene landscape brought a sense of peace to the travelers.

questions.question: In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option. As a fitness ___________, Deepti is always preaching to her friends about the importance of working out.
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.

As a fitness ___________, Deepti is always preaching to her friends about the importance of working out.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: enthusiast.

Key Points

  • The correct phrase is ‘fitness enthusiast’, therefore, fitting the blank perfectly.
  • The hint lies in the fact that we need a noun to fill in the sentence, while ‘enthusiastic’ is an adjective.
  • ‘Enthusiasm’ might be a noun but it does not make any sense with Deepti being a ‘fitness enthusiasm’.
  • Also, Deepti being a ‘fitness enthusiastically’ also gives no meaning to the sentence.
  • Hence, 'enthusiast' is the correct answer.

​The corrected form of the sentence is: As a fitness enthusiast, Deepti is always preaching to her friends about the importance of working out.

Additional Information

  • Enthusiasm: Enthusiasm refers to a strong and eager interest or excitement about something. (उत्साह)
  • Enthusiast: An enthusiast is a person who has a strong and passionate interest in a particular activity, subject, or hobby. (प्रशंसक)
  • Enthusiastic: Enthusiastic is an adjective used to describe someone who shows great excitement, interest, or eagerness about something. (उत्साही)
  • Enthusiastically: Enthusiastically is an adverb that describes an action performed with great enthusiasm or excitement. (उत्साहपूर्वक)

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase. It goes without saying
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase.

It goes without saying

options.text: Something which is implied to be obvious
options.html: Something which is implied to be obvious

options.text: There is no point in doing something after you are told to do it
options.html: There is no point in doing something after you are told to do it

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Something which is implied to be obvious.

Key Points

  • 'It goes without saying' is an idiom used to represent something obvious. (कुछ ऐसा जो स्पष्ट होने के लिए निहित हो)
  • Option 2 is the closest in meaning, therefore, the best answer.
  • The idiom can be used in the sentence: ‘It goes without saying that new joinees must be trained carefully’.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 2.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the words/sentence. Excessively lengthy speech
